rule: exactly these three scenarios; all use the same execution model, fee schedule, stale policy and data-quality policy, so coverage is comparable; they differ only in latency and slippage. Defined before any real-data inspection; never chosen or tuned on returns

scenarios.definition: touch + fees, no latency, no extra slippage (lower bound of cost; not a realistic fill)
best defensible current model: touch at decision + 1 s, displayed-depth walk for the order notional, fees; UNAVAILABLE (no fallback) wherever the depth cannot support the walk

adverse but plausible: touch at decision + 5 s, displayed-depth walk PLUS a fixed 10 bps per side add-on, fees; latency changes WHICH state is met (market movement, reported as latency_drift_bps), it is not itself a cost

sensitivity_only: X0-S1-ZERO / LOW / MODERATE / SEVERE may be reported as a sensitivity table next to a scenario; they are not additional scenarios
